name: Color Picker
description: Cross-platform screen color picker with format conversion, contrast checking, and AI color tools.
author: Asyar

preferences.name: defaultFormat
preferences.title: Default copy format
preferences.description: Format used when a picked color is copied to the clipboard.

preferences.name: historyLimit
preferences.title: History size limit
preferences.description: Maximum number of non-favorited colors kept in history.

preferences.name: uppercaseHex
preferences.title: Uppercase hex
preferences.description: Render hex codes as #AABBCC instead of #aabbcc.

preferences.name: trayIconEnabled
preferences.title: Show tray icon
preferences.description: Show a menu-bar swatch of the last-picked color with quick access to Pick Color and recent colors.

commands.name: Pick Color
commands.description: Sample any pixel on screen and copy it in your default format

commands.name: Color History
commands.description: Browse, search, favorite, and copy previously picked colors

commands.name: Convert Color
commands.description: Convert a color between formats, check contrast, and get AI suggestions
